## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Financials and Energy leadership while Technology also contributing; style tilt toward Value/Cyclical given Energy + Financials strength.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: PSX (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +3.49%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.96% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +9.09% | 1M: -8.59%) RECOVERY. Healthcare strong: GILD (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.95%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +11.60%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.12% | 1M: +5.90%) ABOVE TREND. Financials are constructive: SCHW (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +15.70%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?

Consumer Discretionary soft: TSLA (1W: -4.41% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -5.95% | 1M: +5.91%) CORRECTION. Industrials showing short-term weakness: CAT (1W: -5.35% | 1M: +2.48%) CORRECTION, DE (1W: -5.53% | 1M: +3.62%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: OXY (1W: +9.09% | 1M: -8.59%) RECOVERY; PSX (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +3.49%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +8.60% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND; ACN (1W: +7.32% | 1M: -19.32%) RECOVERY. 5. Worst Performing Stocks?

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: OXY (1W: +9.09%), PSX (1W: +8.78%), AVGO (1W: +8.60%), AAPL (1W: +7.42%), ACN (1W: +7.32%). Watch major divergences: AMAT (1W: -9.56% | 1M: +19.61%) CORRECTION, LRCX (1W: -9.74% | 1M: +8.93%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -11.40% | 1M: +2.06%) CORRECTION — MAJOR divergence present, monitor for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive with short-term rotation; AAPL (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +8.60% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.81%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -6.65%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -1.22%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Tech: 13/24 positive (Internal Rotation).

8. Financials Outlook?
Broadly constructive; SCHW (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +15.70%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +8.92%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Financials: 14/20 positive (Sector Strength).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive support within the rally; GILD (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.95%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +11.60%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.12% | 1M: +5.90%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 12/17 positive (Sector Strength).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Financials and Energy leaders while selectively adding Technology names showing confirmed above-trend performance; reduce exposure to Materials and selected Industrials in short term given CORRECTION patterns. With MAJOR divergence across several large-cap tech and chip-equipment names, treat new Tech entries as tactical until 1M/1W alignment confirms.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PSX (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +3.49%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +15.70%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +8.60% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AMAT (1W: -9.56% | 1M: +19.61%) CORRECTION, LRCX (1W: -9.74% | 1M: +8.93%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -11.40% | 1M: +2.06%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Sector breadth supportive; Energy: 6/10 positive), Financials (Financials: 14/20 positive). BEARISH: Materials (Materials: 3/11 positive), Consumer Discretionary (Consumer Disc.: 4/14 positive) — watch industrial names showing trend exhaustion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
AAPL support pivot to watch: AAPL (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND — hold recent breakout; NVDA (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.81%) RECOVERY — watch 1M confirmation; SCHW (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +15.70%) ABOVE TREND — continued breadth confirmation would signal Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GILD (+80): Gilead approvals headline; GILD (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.95%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. PFE (+75): FDA oncology narrative; PFE (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -5.35%) RECOVERY — news aligns with short-term bounce. AVGO (+55): Apple-related upside; AVGO (1W: +8.60% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND — price confirms sentiment. AAPL (+50): Apple commit headline; AAPL (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND — confirmed. AMZN (+50): product/AI initiative; AMZN (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND — confirmatory.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
HD (-50): concerns on pro-focused pivot; HD (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirmed by short-term pullback. Other names flagged in news (ORCL -55, CRM -50) show negative headlines but lack detailed 1W/1M metrics in this brief for cross-check; monitor for confirmation or divergence.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Value/Cyclical tilt. PSX ABOVE TREND, SCHW ABOVE TREND and AAPL ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across several large-cap tech/chip names (AMAT, LRCX, INTC) and mixed news signals warrant monitoring for trend breaks.
